name: Hit Points
description: Damage reduces current hit points; healing restores them up to maximum.

name: Dropping to Zero Hit Points
description: At 0 HP a creature normally falls unconscious and makes death saves, unless killed outright or subject to another rule.

name: Instant Death
description: If damage reduces you to 0 HP and remaining damage equals or exceeds your hit point maximum, you die instantly.

name: Damage Resistance
description: Resistance halves damage of the relevant type, rounding down.

name: Damage Vulnerability
description: Vulnerability doubles damage of the relevant type.

name: Temporary Hit Points
description: Temporary HP absorb damage before normal HP, do not stack, and cannot be restored by healing.

name: Stabilizing a Creature
description: Use an action to make a DC 10 Wisdom (Medicine) check to stabilize a creature at 0 HP; a stabilized creature remains unconscious.
